invariants.rationale: The method returns the merged parent/template Element, which should not be null unless there's an error, in which case an exception is thrown.
The method always creates and returns a merged Element, not simply the original parent element.
The merged Element is based on 'templateObjectElement' whose name is 'object', as extracted from the template.
The method accesses 'mapElement.getAttribute' and passes 'mapElement' to merging, so it must not be null.
The merge generates a new Element instance that is not identical to 'mapElement'.
